title: Elderly Couple Outdoors, 1940s Black & White Snapshot
description: A black-and-white mid-century snapshot depicting an elderly couple standing side-by-side in a shaded yard setting. The man is dressed in a formal three-piece suit, vest, and tie, while the woman wears a distinctive polka dot dress. In the background near a porch structure, a woman and a young girl in a patterned dress can be seen observing. The photograph features decorative scalloped/deckled borders popular in mid-20th-century photo processing.
